messages:
maya: Quick sync — ValleyHealth onboarding SLA visibility needed. They're asking for latency SLO baseline + credit calc for the incidents last week. Need a one-pager for customer by Friday EOD. Can someone pull evidence and a short credit breakdown? Thanks.

jared: What exact SLO numbers do we commit for onboarding? Is it 99.9% uptime and p95 < 300ms? Their contract draft shows 99.5% / p95 250ms but want to confirm what we actually measured.

priya: I can run the enablement session and draft the customer-facing language. Will need p50/p95/p99 and a couple sample traces. @sam_ops can you export a lightweight CSV and a couple spans?

sam_ops: On it. Pulling p95 for last 7d now — will upload artifacts. Dashboard link for quick reference: https://console.redwood.ai/slo/valleyhealth — ETA ~30m.

ops-bot: Incident summary uploaded: https://redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/valley/incident-2026-03-10-summary.pdf :memo:

sam_ops: Copy of the query I used (quick and dirty): `SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) AS p95, count(*) FROM requests WHERE tenant = 'valleyhealth' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days';`  Uploaded CSV to drive when done.

maya: Perfect — for the credit calc, remember our policy: credits = min((downtime_minutes / total_billing_minutes) * invoice_amount, credit_cap). For partial-latency breaches we map time-in-degradation into buckets. Can someone estimate the credit for the three incidents last week?

jared: I'll run the calc in the shared spreadsheet. Quick Q: do we offset credits against reserved capacity commitments or treat separately? @finance please confirm — otherwise I'll assume credits reduce the next invoice.

priya: Draft outline for the one-pager: 1) SLOs (measured vs committed) 2) Incident summaries + timeline 3) Credit calc table (per-incident) 4) Remediation + next steps (enablement + runbook + proactive monitoring). I can do the customer wording and a short FAQ.

maya: Timeline: internal draft Thu EOD, review Fri morning, customer send Fri afternoon. :calendar:

sam_ops: Uploaded CSV and two sample traces here: https://drive.redwood.com/valley/onboard-evidence.csv. Also attached a p95 trend screenshot.

jared: Got the files, running numbers now. I'll loop in finance offline if needed. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — note: if credits exceed ~3% of monthly bill we flag renewal risk and AE should own outreach. I want a quick renewal-impact estimate in the one-pager.

jared: Noted, tagging @elaine-am for awareness so AE can prep if we cross threshold.

elaine-am: Thanks for the heads-up. I'll draft a short outreach playbook and legal checklist in case credits materially change the renewal terms.

maya: Great. @priya I'll DM you the customer-facing language samples. Will post the internal draft here when ready. :white_check_mark:
